Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.12200

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2023).
source_name: Yan-Ting Xie, Yong-De Feng and Shou-Jun Xu, “A characterization of regular partial cubes whose all convex cycles have the same lengths”, arXiv:2301.12200 (2024).
statement: Let $G$ be a vertex-transitive partial cube with girth $6$. **Marc's conjecture.** Doubled Odd graphs are the only vertex-transitive partial cubes with girth $6$. This conjecture proposes that the known Doubled Odd graphs exhaust the vertex-transitive partial cubes of girth $6$; its resolution is not established in the supplied text.
title: Marc's conjecture on vertex-transitive partial cubes of girth 6
